name: Nishijou Kanna
source:
A seemingly prim and proper college student. Hailing from a respectable family, her actions are brimming with elegance. 

"Did you really think that a prim and elegant woman like me won't have tongue piercings?"

[Translated from [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_221.html]Official Site[/url]]
